templates.title: Mediarium
templates.name: mediarium
templates.description: All-in-one media manager for movies and TV: search Usenet and torrent indexers, download with built-in clients, unpack and organise your library.
templates.note: Put your downloads, movies and TV inside one data folder so finished downloads are hardlinked. After deploying, open http://<server-ip>:8264 and follow the setup wizard. Guide: docs/INSTALL.md

env.name: DATA_PATH
env.label: Data folder (host)
env.description: ONE folder on the host that holds downloads, movies and TV. Mounted as /data.

env.name: CONFIG_PATH
env.label: Config folder (host)
env.description: Folder on the host for Mediarium's database and key. Back it up.

env.name: PUID
env.label: PUID
env.description: User ID that owns your media folders (run 'id' on the host).

env.name: PGID
env.label: PGID
env.description: Group ID that owns your media folders.

env.name: WEBUI_PORT
env.label: Web port
env.description: Port for the web page on the host.
